question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as attainments
Great accomplishment is associated with these attainments
Such accomplishment leads to becoming dear to the yoginīs
inference: One who possesses great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation.
